ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels comprise approximately 85% of the visible surface; low-intensity black pixels comprise approximately 15%, localized to the trailing edges and the central midline plume.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous jagged band along the trailing edge. Distinct black circular blobs are positioned at the mid-left lobe and a cluster of three is located in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations. The right lobe trailing edge features approximately 8 distinct peaks of varying pixel-depth. The left lobe trailing edge displays lower-frequency, tighter serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer margins tapering to sharp, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of high-contrast circular black clusters: one isolated spot on the mid-left lobe; three clustered spots on the mid-right lobe; several small clusters along the right distal margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three parallel, low-intensity vertical linear marks (rake marks) detected on the right lobe surface near the outer third margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately midway between the center and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellow-brown hue (diatom film) across the lower-central third of both fluke lobes, contrasting with the primary white pigmentation.
